observed_original_abi.return_type_rationale: 0x00b723c0 is a bare RET with no immediate and EAX is never written by the body, so nothing is returned; the value the dispatched slot leaves in EAX is discarded by the next iteration, which reloads EAX at 0x00b723aa.

ghidra_convention_note: The live Ghidra decompilation warns 'Unknown calling convention' and renders the signature as (cObjectPool_ *this, cObjectPoolIndex index), deriving the second formal from in_ECX - 4. The disassembly pushes no stack word at entry and returns with a plain RET, so the observed ordinary stack argument slot count is zero and that formal is a derived word, not a parameter.
observed_mechanics: 0x00b72370-0x00b72373 PUSH EBX, PUSH ESI, PUSH EDI, MOV ESI,ECX saves three registers and keeps the receiver in ESI.
0x00b72375 CALL 0x00883860 pushes no argument; 0x00b7237a MOV EDI,EAX consumes the result as an object pointer.

0x00883860 is 'undefined4 FUN_00883860(void) { return DAT_016514cc; }' and 0x00883870 is its setter (returns the old word, stores its argument). The three xrefs to 0x016514cc are READ 0x00883860, READ 0x00883874, WRITE 0x00883879, so the getter/setter pair is the only access path in the image.
0x00b7237c LEA EBX,[ESI + -0x4] derives the receiver word minus four; it is the only other value the body produces and it is passed as an opaque 32-bit word, never dereferenced.

0x00b7237f-0x00b72393 stores five words unconditionally, before either null test: [receiver+0x20] = dispatch pointer, [receiver+0x24] = receiver-4, [receiver+0x28] = 0x01465004, [receiver+0x2c] = 8, [receiver+0x30] = 0.
0x00b7239a TEST EDI,EDI / 0x00b7239c JZ 0x00b723bd skips the loop when the dispatch pointer is zero.
0x00b7239e TEST EBX,EBX / 0x00b723a0 JZ 0x00b723bd skips the loop when the receiver-minus-four word is zero.
0x00b723a2-0x00b723bb runs a byte index from 0 to 0x20 in steps of 4, that is eight iterations, reading each word through the absolute base 0x01465004.

0x00b723aa MOV EAX,[EDI] and 0x00b723ac MOV EDX,[EAX+0x24] re-read the dispatch object's vtable pointer and its slot word at displacement 0x24 on every iteration, so overwriting the slot mid-loop changes the callee.

0x00b723af-0x00b723b3 PUSH ECX, PUSH EBX, MOV ECX,EDI, CALL EDX: callee-visible stack order is slot 0 = the receiver-minus-four word, slot 1 = the current 0x01465004 word, with the dispatch object as the ECX receiver.
No ADD ESP or RET n appears between CALL EDX and the loop increment, so the dispatched slot reclaims its own two words; the loop keeps the stack flat.
0x00b723bd-0x00b723c0 POP EDI, POP ESI, POP EBX, RET performs no stack cleanup and returns no value.
The eight source words at 0x01465004 are read only; the body writes nothing back to that window.

unresolved_questions: Is the receiver-minus-four word (LEA EBX,[ESI + -0x4]) a cObjectPoolIndex as the SDK decompilation names it, an adjusted this, or an unrelated token? The disassembly pushes no stack argument, so the SDK's second formal cannot be a parameter and the word is never dereferenced by this body.

What concrete class carries the vtable whose slot at displacement 0x24 is dispatched here, and what is the meaning of the (token, source word) argument pair? No RTTI, no vtable label, and no SDK name for the dispatch target is recovered.

What is the relationship, if any, between the immediate slot-0x24 dispatch in this body and the slot-0x2c dispatch that 0x00b79a60 performs over the same five published words? The arity and the slot differ, and no call path between the two functions was recovered.

Is 0x014650e8 the true base of the containing vtable, or is it a word inside a larger class-registration table? The run is contiguous but sits next to class-name strings and a NULL separator, and the class owner is unknown.
Why is the source window at 0x01465004 a fixed eight-word global table rather than data owned by the receiver? No writer, no owner, and no SDK name for those eight words is recovered.

The conflict ledger entry U-008-scenario-respawner lists this address among state-event anchors but reports the transition policy, consumer order, and runtime reachability as unresolved; that ledger entry is unchanged by this reconstruction.
